adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `actions.next`/`previous` update `group.offset` and immediately call `group.findMembers()` without any in-flight/request-order guard. In `discourse/models/group.js`, `findMembers()` issues an AJAX request and in its `.then` unconditionally `setProperties({ user_count, limit, offset, members })` from the response. With rapid clicking, multiple `/members.json?offset=...` requests can overlap and resolve out of order, allowing an older/slower response to overwrite `offset`/`members` with stale data (race condition).
